question: Can causal internal deterioration declare a slow destructive bear before an MA cross using breadth collapse/non-recovery, failed rebounds, negative-day persistence, and lagged funding/credit deterioration?

breadth: change in breadth-above-SMA200 over trailing 20/30/40 sessions
failed_rebounds: fraction of sessions in trailing 20/30/40 where 5-day return <=0 while drawdown252<-5%

thresholds: rolling historical percentiles using past observations only; bounded percentiles 70/75/80/85/90
rule_family: sparse confluence requiring at least one breadth/internal-damage condition and at least one funding/credit condition; 2-4 clauses; confirmation 1/2/3/5 sessions
controls: all non-positive evaluable history; 2011, 2015 and 2018 explicitly retained
validation: leave-one-positive-out plus full-history descriptive; a positive episode cannot determine thresholds for its heldout fold
